--tl-color-bg-canvas: App background. White in light mode, divided by lines and space (PR-27)
--tl-color-bg-sunken: Light cells inside a surface (grid header, label column, icon box), hover and skeletons (PR-27)
--tl-color-fg-primary: Body text. 12:1 or more against surface
--tl-color-fg-secondary: Secondary text. 4.5:1 or more (PR-26: 600 → 700 for readability)
--tl-color-fg-tertiary: Hints and timestamps. 4.5:1 or more (PR-26: 500 → 600; 500 was 4.47:1 on canvas)
--tl-color-border-strong: Emphasis border, replaces shadows in dark mode
--tl-color-border-divider: Dividers (PR-26: dark 800 → 700 so card and frame edges show)
--tl-color-brand-default: Primary actions (note D-10). Dark uses 600 with white text, the same as light (PR-26)
--tl-color-brand-hover: Primary action hover. One step darker
--tl-color-approval-draft-default: Approval (draft): badge dot · approval line marker (text uses the text token)
--tl-color-approval-draft-text: Approval (draft): badge text (4.5:1 on subtle, D-64)
--tl-color-approval-pending-default: Approval (in progress): badge dot · approval line marker (text uses the text token)
--tl-color-approval-pending-text: Approval (in progress): badge text (4.5:1 on subtle, D-64)
--tl-color-approval-approved-default: Approval (approved): badge dot · approval line marker (text uses the text token)
--tl-color-approval-approved-text: Approval (approved): badge text (4.5:1 on subtle, D-64)
--tl-color-approval-rejected-default: Approval (rejected): badge dot · approval line marker (text uses the text token)
--tl-color-approval-rejected-text: Approval (rejected): badge text (4.5:1 on subtle, D-64)
--tl-color-approval-withdrawn-default: Approval (withdrawn): badge dot · approval line marker (text uses the text token)
--tl-color-approval-withdrawn-text: Approval (withdrawn): badge text (4.5:1 on subtle, D-64)
--tl-color-module-erp-default: ERP: active sidebar item and badge
--tl-color-module-groupware-default: Groupware: active sidebar item and badge
--tl-color-module-ecm-default: ECM: active sidebar item and badge
--tl-color-module-crm-default: CRM: active sidebar item and badge
--tl-color-module-scm-default: Distribution and logistics: active sidebar item and badge (provisional, D-53)
--tl-color-module-scm-subtle: Distribution and logistics: module card background (provisional)
--tl-color-module-scm-gradient-from: Distribution and logistics: app icon gradient top (provisional)
--tl-color-module-scm-gradient-to: Distribution and logistics: app icon gradient bottom (provisional)
--tl-color-module-commerce-default: E-commerce: active sidebar item and badge (provisional, D-53)
--tl-color-module-mes-default: Manufacturing: active sidebar item and badge (provisional, D-53)
--tl-color-module-on-tile: Lines and text on module app icons (generated fallback). White in both light and dark mode (D-36, provisional)
--tl-color-chart-series-1: Chart series 1: single series or current period (ERP color)
--tl-color-chart-track: Bar tracks, empty cells, donut background
--tl-color-chart-heat-3: Sequential step 3. Text on steps 1 to 3 uses fg.primary
--tl-color-chart-heat-4: Sequential step 4. Text on steps 4 and 5 uses chart.heatInk
--tl-color-chart-heat-ink: Text on sequential steps 4 and 5 (light text in dark mode)
--tl-density-input-font-size: Input text. 16 on phones (touch). iOS zooms the screen when an input smaller than 16 gets focus
--tl-font-family-sans: The first entry is the bundled font. The rest are fallbacks (D-22)
--tl-easing-standard: Default transition. Provisional (pending G2 approval, D-21)
--tl-shadow-sm: Cards. Provisional (pending G2 approval, D-21). Dark mode uses border.strong instead of a shadow
--tl-shadow-md: Dropdowns. Provisional (pending G2 approval, D-21). Dark mode uses border.strong instead of a shadow
--tl-shadow-lg: Modals. Provisional (pending G2 approval, D-21). Dark mode uses border.strong instead of a shadow
--tl-type-body-font-size: Body text. In compact, density.body.* overrides it
--tl-paper-fg: Paper body text. Prints as solid black. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-muted: Top line, bottom line and note text. 4.5:1 or more on bg and fill. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-line: Inner table cell lines and the line above the footer. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-line-strong: Outer table border and the line above the total row. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-fill: Table header and label cell background. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-shadow: Paper shadow in the on-screen preview. Not printed. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-margin-sm: Narrow margin. National Tax Service forms with many cells and A5. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-margin-md: Default margin. Certificates, statements and invoices. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-display-font-size: Document title (PaperTitle). The same size as 28px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-display-line-height: display line height. The same as 36px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-h1-font-size: Document title in compact. The same size as 24px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-h1-line-height: h1 line height. The same as 32px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-h2-font-size: Signature line (company, title and name). The same size as 20px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-h2-line-height: h2 line height. The same as 28px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-h3-font-size: Group titles, confirmation sentence and signature date. The signature line in compact. The same size as 16px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-h3-line-height: h3 line height. The same as 24px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-body-font-size: Paper body text and table cells. Group titles and the confirmation sentence in compact. The same size as 14px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-body-line-height: body line height. The same as 20px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-label-font-size: Body text and table cells in compact. The same size as 13px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-label-line-height: label line height. The same as 18px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-caption-font-size: Top line, bottom line, notes and the note above a table. The same size as 12px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-paper-type-caption-line-height: caption line height. The same as 16px. Draft (pending approval)
--tl-color-bg-nav: Sidebar surface: the darkest brand step, same in light and dark. Text on it uses color.nav.* (PR-27)
--tl-color-border-selected: Selected and current markers (1px outline, tab underline, current step). 3:1 or more against surface (PR-26)
--tl-duration-fast: Hover, active and selection changes (background, text color, border); small popups (Menu, Popover, Tooltip)
--tl-duration-slower: Bottom sheets, toasts, progress bar width
--tl-duration-spin: One turn of something that spins (Spinner)
--tl-duration-pulse: One cycle of a repeating indicator (skeleton, blink, progress line)
--tl-density-row-height-tall: Rows with a two-line cell (name plus a second line). row.height × 1.4, rounded (PR-26)
--tl-color-nav-fg-muted: Sidebar section names, icons and chevrons
--tl-color-nav-fg-active: Current screen and hovered item text in the sidebar
--tl-color-nav-selected: Sidebar current screen surface (no left rail)
--tl-color-nav-focus: Focus ring on the sidebar (3:1 on nav and selected)
--tl-color-bg-row-selected: Selected row background in tables and lists (D-97)
--tl-color-nav-sub: Sidebar background behind an expanded submenu group (D-97)
--tl-color-fg-strong: Titles and emphasized values. One step darker than fg.primary (D-97)
--tl-color-border-focus-strong: Focus ring in strong-focus mode (data-focus="strong") and high contrast. 4.5:1 on surface and canvas (D-97)
--tl-color-brand-tint: Light accent area (range band, cell being edited, drop target, progress track). Text on it uses fg.primary (D-97)
--tl-color-brand-accent: The company color as is, for non-text accents (progress bar, logo, selection dot). 3:1 on surface (D-97)
--tl-density-control-height-xs: Smallest control (buttons and chips inside tables). On touch devices the hit area grows (D-97)
--tl-border-width-3: Focus ring in strong-focus mode (data-focus="strong", D-97)
--tl-font-family-mono: Code and numbers. System monospace only; no font file is bundled (no external network, D-97)
--tl-layout-content-max-width-wide: Maximum body width on wide screens (layout.wide.minWidth and up, D-97)
--tl-layout-wide-min-width: Width where wide screens start. Media queries use this number as is (D-97)
--tl-duration-essential: A duration that does not drop to 0 under reduced motion. Only the status spinner uses it (D-97)
--tl-size-touch-min: Minimum for anything pressed with a finger (WCAG 2.5.5, iOS 44, D-97)
--tl-size-touch-control: Finger-sized control (xl of Button, Input, Select)
--tl-size-touch-main: Main action that must be pressed (fixed bottom button, list row)
--tl-type-micro-font-size: Badge numbers, axis ticks and very small marks (D-97)
--tl-type-mono-font-size: Code and numbers. Font is font.family.mono (D-97)
